_note: One-line business meaning of the tables people ask about, and of columns whose name alone is not enough. describe_table / list_database_tables show these next to the live schema. Written from the ERP's own reports; the module owners confirm them (docs/AI/ai.md step 0.7).

sales_orders.about: A customer sales order (header). Counts as a sale when status is confirmed, processing or completed; draft and cancelled are not sales.

columns.status: draft -> confirmed -> processing -> completed, or cancelled
columns.delivery_status: pending until goods are delivered, then delivered
columns.invoice_number: set once the order is invoiced (with invoiced_at)

sales_order_lines.about: Lines of a sales order: item, quantity ordered / delivered / returned, unit price.

columns.quantity_delivered: how many were delivered so far

sales_invoices.about: Customer invoices (bills we send). Money owed lives in finance_receivables.

sales_quotations.about: Customer quotations; sales_order_id is set once converted to an order.

sales_returns.about: Goods a customer sent back; credit_amount is what we credit them.

commerce_customers.about: The customer master (one row per customer). total_spend / total_orders / last_order_date are kept on the row; party_id links the shared partner master.

columns.credit_limit: the most this customer may owe us

commerce_orders.about: ONLINE storefront orders (the website). Not the same as sales_orders (the ERP sales module).

commerce_suppliers.about: The supplier master: whom we buy from.

parties.about: Shared partner master behind customers and suppliers (type customer, vendor or both).

columns.status: draft -> confirmed -> partial_received -> completed, or cancelled

purchase_receipts.about: Goods received against a purchase order (GRN).

purchase_bills.about: Supplier bills; what we owe lives in finance_payables.

items.about: The item master (every product / part we stock or sell). catalog_products rows link to it by item_id.

inventory_stock_levels.about: Current stock: one row per item per warehouse. Stock value = sum(on_hand * unit_cost) here, never from catalog prices.

columns.reorder_level: below this the item is 'low stock'

inventory_stock_movements.about: The history behind every stock change: movement_type, quantity, qty_before / qty_after, reference (the document that caused it).

inventory_warehouses.about: Warehouses / locations; is_default marks the main one.

inventory_stock_adjustments.about: Manual stock corrections (header). Lines are in inventory_stock_adjustment_lines.

inventory_stock_transfers.about: Stock moved from one warehouse to another (header).

catalog_products.about: Website products. status is draft or published (a draft is never on the site); price = selling price, compare_at_price = old price, purchase_price = cost.

columns.source_url: the page the product was copied from (AI import)

finance_receivables.about: Money customers owe us (AR). Open when balance > 0; overdue when due_date has passed.

finance_payables.about: Money we owe suppliers (AP). Open when balance > 0.

finance_journal_entries.about: Accounting journal entries; lines in finance_journal_lines (debit / credit).

hrm_employees.about: Employees. department_id / designation_id / branch_id point to the name tables.

hrm_attendance_records.about: Daily attendance: clock_in / clock_out, is_late, is_absent, total_hours.

crm_leads.about: Prospects before they become a deal.

crm_deals.about: Sales opportunities with a stage and a value.
